mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park and an air quality index of 54, which is currently in the moderate range.

The Verona Finance Department has released the proposed 2027 budget, and the Plan Commission is reviewing multiple development proposals, including the Ardent Glen plat and site plans for Milky Way, on November 4th.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for yoga on October 26 and various trivia nights starting October 27.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15 where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I, though thankfully no students were injured during the encounter.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle, which is a local favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head over to enjoy a treat.
